title: Aurora Dedicated POC — Infosec Questionnaire & Evidence Packet
document_text:
Purpose and scope:
This packet consolidates Redwood Inference responses to Aurora HealthTech’s security questionnaire for the Dedicated POC (customer-managed VPC peering). It includes concise Q&A, pointers to evidence artifacts, a short risk/mitigation summary, and workshop notes from the security review call. Evidence covers artifacts collected between 2025-10-20 and 2025-11-01.

POC context (short):
- Customer: Aurora HealthTech (POC only)
- Deployment: Dedicated (reserved GPU pool) into Aurora-managed VPC peering; Redwood control plane partially hosted
- Data in scope: pseudonymized patient metadata, application prompts (explicitly instructed to avoid raw PHI in POC), ops telemetry logs

One-line executive summary:
Redwood provided the requested technical controls for Dedicated POC: VPC isolation, customer KMS integration, RBAC via SCIM/SAML with MFA, encrypted storage and TLS in transit, and audit logs exported to customer S3. Three items remain open (SLA wording, telemetry retention waiver, pentest remediation proof) and are tracked below.

Condensed questionnaire responses and evidence pointers:
1) Identity & Access Management- Response: SAML SSO (Okta) + SCIM provisioning used for admin access. Role groups: infra-admin, ops-engineer, se-viewer. MFA enforced for all admin roles.- Evidence pointers: evidence/okta-scim-mapping.png, evidence/saml-assertion-sanitized.txt

2) Network & Perimeter Controls- Response: Dedicated nodes placed in Aurora VPC via peering. Route tables and security groups configured to restrict egress; optional egress ACLs applied by Redwood on request.- Evidence pointers: evidence/network-diagram-aurora-poc.pdf, evidence/route-table-export-20251025.csv

3) Encryption and Key Management- Response: Data at rest encrypted; customer-managed AWS KMS CMK supported and used for this POC. TLS1.2+ in transit; TLS1.3 negotiated when supported.- Evidence pointers: evidence/kms-policy-screenshot.png, evidence/s3-object-meta.txt

4) Logging, Monitoring & Auditability- Response: Audit logs (API, system events, RBAC changes) exported to customer-controlled S3 bucket. Default retention for the POC: 90 days; retention can be customized per contract. Access to logs is IAM-controlled and recorded.- Evidence pointers: evidence/cloudtrail-sample-20251028.json, evidence/kibana-rbac-20251029.png

5) Vulnerability Management & Pen Test- Response: Internal scans quarterly, external pen test annually. Findings tracked in SEC JIRA project; remediation timing driven by severity (P0/P1: 30 days). For the POC we ran a focused internal scan and identified two low-severity items; remediation work is underway.- Evidence pointers: evidence/pentest-summary-2025.pdf (sanitized), JIRA:SEC-2987

6) Change Control & Release Practices- Response: GitHub PRs -> CI -> canary -> rollout; immutable artifacts and automatic rollback on health-check failure. Dedicated deployments use agreed maintenance windows and deployment runbooks.- Evidence pointers: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/987, evidence/deployment-runbook-snippet.txt

7) Incident Response and Notifications- Response: 24x7 on-call SRE rotation, incident runbook, and customer notification timelines defined in contract (initial P0 notice within 1 hour). Post-incident reports include timeline, RCA, impact, and remediation plan.- Evidence pointers: evidence/incident-runbook-redacted.docx, evidence/postmortem-template.md

8) Data Residency & Privacy- Response: POC provisioned in us-west-2 per Aurora’s request. Region pinning and data egress controls are supported for Dedicated/private deployments.- Evidence pointers: evidence/provisioning-manifest-20251020.csv

9) Compliance Attestations- Response: Redwood holds SOC2 Type II (security & availability) as of 2024-09; HIPAA support available for Private deployments/BAA. Excerpts provided for POC review.- Evidence pointers: evidence/SOC2-excerpt-2024.pdf, evidence/BAA-template.docx

Outstanding items and tracked actions (owners & ETA):
- SLA clause: Aurora requested explicit latency SLO for Dedicated. Owner: Ethan Ross. Action: draft SLO wording and send to Aurora. ETA: 2026-03-05.
- Telemetry retention waiver: Aurora legal to confirm acceptable retention beyond 90 days for POC telemetry. Owner: Mariana Silva. Action: reconcile legal language and update packet. ETA: 2026-03-08.
- Pen test remediation verification: Upload dated remediation validation logs for two low-severity findings. Owner: Daniel Kim. Action: attach remediation evidence. ETA: 2026-03-04.

Workshop notes (2025-10-22 security review call highlights):
- Aurora asked for key-access audit log forwarding into their SIEM; agreed to provide a CloudTrail export and S3 delivery hooks.
- They raised a question about model KV cache persistence; we explained cache is memory-scoped and not persisted to shared durable storage in the POC; provided configuration snippet during the call.
- Aurora requested option for outbound firewall whitelisting; noted as infra runbook action and deliverable.

Risk summary (top 3) and mitigations:
- Risk: accidental inclusion of PII in POC prompts. Mitigation: require data minimization, enable ingest-stage prompt scanning and redaction rules, and provide deletion hooks; recommend Aurora avoid PHI in POC uploads.
- Risk: incomplete remediation artifacts for low-severity pentest items. Mitigation: produce remediation verification logs and short-form test evidence.
- Risk: unintended egress during integration. Mitigation: lock down egress via route tables, egress ACLs, and optionally customer-managed firewall rules; verify with capture tests.

Next steps (immediate):
1) Share this packet with Aurora security; request confirmation on outstanding items (Ethan to lead).
2) Upload remediation verification evidence once available (Daniel).
3) Legal/Compliance to finalize SOC2 excerpt mapping and share final PDF (Mariana).

Reviewer notes: Please prioritize checking the outstanding items list. If an evidence artifact references customer secrets or credentials, mark it as "do not share" and the owners will prepare a redacted artifact.
